approved_text: Sleep hygiene supports habits and environment: wake timing, wind-down, light, bedroom comfort, caffeine awareness, meal comfort, activity, and intentional naps. It does not cure OSA and may not be enough for persistent insomnia or medical symptoms.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: sleep hygiene

approved_text: La higiene del sueño apoya hábitos y ambiente: horario, rutina, luz, comodidad, cafeína, comidas, actividad y siestas. No cura AOS y quizá no baste para insomnio persistente o síntomas médicos.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: higiene del sueño

approved_text: Plans may use only non-medical actions: specify a realistic habit, timing, expected barrier, backup plan, observation to record, or question for a care team.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: sleep-habit planning

approved_text: Los planes solo usan acciones no médicas: hábito realista, momento, barrera, plan alternativo, observación o pregunta para el equipo.
source_title: Existing Sleep Education curriculum: planificación de hábitos
